items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Reagan. Now was it, no I didn’t do Reagan. I don’t know if it’s right.

ctx.x: Years ago we had a jazz band, a great jazz band. Anyway he became a producer in New York and I was on everything he did. And soaps, films, he did all music and sometimes he would use Torrie, I’d see Torrie. Torrie would come in with the music. I’d say, “Oh hey man” you know. But the gigs that I did he used to take a band like you would take a rhythm section to Washington and we’d do the Kennedy Center man, you know the Kennedy Center Honors. And it was such a great gig man. And I did about five of them, © Fillius…

five or six of them. Clinton, Bush, who else? Reagan. Now was it, no I didn’t do Reagan. I don’t know if it’s right. Anyway after the gig we’d go to a dinner you know and all of that. I’d take my wife you know. It was really, really a beautiful experience man. That was a great — and then he lost it, Elliot lost it. Another conductor came in. Of course they used their guys. You know. But it was a great gig. The orchestra was great you know, always. And we’d rehearse. We’d go in, we’d pre-record a lot of it there,…
